# Migration waves

Plan: [`migration/waves.yaml`](../../migration/waves.yaml). An exported object is computed on premises and shipped without its direct identifiers; a rebuilt one is recomputed in the cloud from earlier waves.

## Wave 1: Customer reference without identity

Customer, account and card histories (SCD2) rebuilt in the cloud from the core banking change logs, exported without direct identifiers, and the party each customer belongs to, resolved on premises where the names are. Every later wave joins on these keys.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bronze.corebanking_customer` | export | 167,848 | 7.4 | `first_name`, `last_name`, `legal_name`, `id_document_number`, `tax_id`, `address_line`, `phone`, `email` | `customer_id`, `gender`, `birth_date`, `nationality`, `residence_country`, `occupation`, `city`, `postal_code`, `is_pep` |
| `bronze.corebanking_account` | export | 518,581 | 15.1 |  | `account_id`, `customer_id`, `account_number`, `rib` |
| `bronze.corebanking_card` | export | 87,451 | 2.7 |  | `card_id`, `account_id`, `card_token`, `pan_last4` |
| `audit.change_batch` | export | 9 | 0.0 |  |  |
| `silver.customer_history` | rebuild | 167,848 | 1.3 |  | `customer_id`, `gender`, `birth_year`, `nationality`, `residence_country`, `city`, `occupation`, `is_pep` |
| `silver.account_history` | rebuild | 518,581 | 5.8 |  | `account_id`, `customer_id`, `account_number` |
| `silver.card_history` | rebuild | 87,451 | 1.2 |  | `card_id`, `account_id`, `card_token` |
| `silver.party_member` | export | 167,848 | 0.4 |  | `customer_id`, `party_id` |

## Retired

| Relation | Replaced by |
|---|---|
| `audit.ingestion_run` | Lakeflow job run history. |
| `audit.ingestion_file` | The cloud ingestion registry of landed exports and their manifests (step 3). |
